projects.title: Lead Routing Reliability Demo
projects.summary: A lead-intake and routing workflow built to survive the boring failures that break real automations: duplicates, partial failures, retries and replay.
bullets: Safe replay without duplicate side effects
projects.one_liner: Lead intake that survives duplicates, dead APIs and partial failures — verified by 23 acceptance tests.
projects.problem: Lead workflows in the wild break on the boring stuff: the same webhook fires twice, an API 503s mid-run, a step fails halfway and the retry creates a duplicate lead. Most demos only show the happy path.
projects.build: An n8n lead-intake and routing workflow where every webhook receipt is idempotent (duplicate deliveries collapse to one record), validation gates entry, retries use backoff with explicit failure paths, and a safe replay recovers failed runs without duplicating side effects. Every decision is logged for audit.
reliability: Idempotency keys on intake — duplicate webhooks collapse to a single record
Retries with backoff and explicit failure paths — no silent loops
Safe replay: failed runs re-execute without double-processing
Failure alerts instead of silent breakage
Audit trail of every route decision
projects.proof: 23/23 acceptance tests in the repo's evidence/acceptance-summary.json — covering duplicate delivery, transient failure, replay and routing edge cases. Demo uses synthetic data.
projects.link_note: Watch a valid lead run, a duplicate get blocked, and the reliability checks in action.

projects.title: AI Lead Classifier
projects.summary: A real LLM call inside n8n using Hive / GLM 5.3 Flash. The workflow trusts nothing blindly: output is parsed, schema-validated, routed and rejected cleanly when the model misbehaves.
bullets: Malformed output returns an error, not a guess
projects.one_liner: A real LLM call inside n8n that trusts nothing blindly — validated, retried, and failed clearly when the model misbehaves. 9/9 tests.
projects.problem: Most LLM integrations break quietly: the model returns malformed JSON, the API 503s, or output drifts from the schema — and the workflow routes garbage anyway.
projects.build: An n8n workflow making a real Hive API call to GLM 5.3 Flash for lead classification (category, urgency, intent). The response is parsed and schema-validated before routing; transient failures retry with backoff; malformed or invalid output returns a clean rejection — never a guess. Forced-failure tests prove each path.
reliability: Schema validation before any routing decision
Malformed output → explicit error, not a fabricated result
Forced-failure test path proves the failure branch works
Structured JSON output consumed downstream without re-parsing
projects.proof: 9/9 test cases passed (test_cases.json, retry-evidence.json, results.json in repo). Real screenshots: workflow canvas + successful execution. Demo uses synthetic data.

projects.title: Opportunity Engine
projects.summary: A private, mobile-first acquisition control system that finds opportunities, scores them, drafts outreach, tracks replies and manages follow-ups while keeping outbound actions approval-gated.
bullets: Gmail send / reply watcher with idempotency
Lead scoring, approval gates and follow-up cancellation
projects.one_liner: A private acquisition-control system: discovers opportunities, scores them, drafts outreach — and sends nothing without a human approval tap.
projects.problem: Solo operators drown in lead sources: a forum post here, a job board there, replies lost in email. Manual tracking loses follow-ups; full-auto outreach is reckless.
projects.build: A private, mobile-first control system: n8n orchestrates continuous discovery from multiple sources; a local engine scores and dedupes leads, drafts tailored outreach, and routes every send through an approval gate on Jawad's phone. Gmail send + reply watcher, automatic follow-up scheduling with cancellation on reply, budget tracking, backups.
projects.flow: discover → qualify → research → draft → approve → send → monitor reply → follow-up/cancel
reliability: Approval gate — nothing sends without an explicit human tap
Reply detection mirrors inbound email into the lead thread
Follow-up auto-cancellation when a reply lands
Audit trail on every state change; scheduled backups; cost guardrails
projects.proof: 22/22 live regression tests passed (API, qualification, failure handling). Controlled Gmail loop verified end-to-end. Mobile QA passed at 390×844. Sanitized architecture diagram only — no operational data.
